market_portfolios.how_to_read: Values are FantasyCalc dynasty trade values (superflex, 12 teams, full PPR). move30 = 30-day market move of the players held now (trade-neutral). since_change = change since the snapshot dated `since` (includes trades). sidelined = value on IR/Out/PUP. trade_finder.how: Each suggestion comes from the Trade Finder logic: one side has a real need (the offered players would raise its starting lineup) or, for a rebuilder, the deal fits its timeline; the two sides are within 10% in FantasyCalc market value; each team is read as a contender, retooling or rebuilder. Build the issue's hypothetical trades from these (a and b are the two managers; as/bs are already in issue wording, keep them as written so the values and the Load in trade calculator link work). Write the desk commentary yourself; do not invent assets or values.

Darkspaces.tagline: Commissioner, negotiator, and two perfect lineups with nothing to show.
file: The type
A commissioner who competes, and a competitor who negotiates in public. Every roster move comes with an audience.
Signature move
Naming a price in the chat, then renegotiating it live. Swift for next year's 1st, Collins on the block, and Achane staying in the IR slot till next year.
Nemesis
The ceiling. Perfect lineups in Weeks 4 and 5, 118.36 and 140.36, lost by 65.06 and 23.2.
The desk is watching
Whether the block becomes a trade before the deadline, and a FAAB budget that is down to $104.

2026.headline: Two perfect lineups, two losses, and the 1.01 by 7.06
story: The draft set the tone. Darkspaces cut the pick timer to a minute, loaded up on receivers, and handed nicknames to twenty-three of his own players, then spent the first waiver run buying a tight end he had not drafted for $101 and Singleton for $301 on top of it. That is $402 gone before the first Monday night, and the wallet is down to $104.

The pattern since is spend big, sell high, talk loudly. Deebo Samuel went to Snipe58 for a 2027 2nd, Colston Loveland went for Jake Ferguson, and Matthew Stafford went to the same buyer for two future 2nds and $100 of FAAB. Week 5 brought no trade, only talk: Zygon asked about Achane, Darkspaces said Achane is going to sit in his IR slot, and the commissioner roasted himself in the chat before anyone else could.

The record is 2-3, ninth in the standings. Drake Maye was the QB of the week at 39.46 and Darkspaces set a perfect lineup, 140.36 with nothing left on the bench, and still lost by 23.2 to Johnny4Skins. It is his second perfect lineup in a row and his second loss. The 649.28 MAXPF is the lowest in the league, which holds the 1.01 by 7.06 points over Snipe58. The commissioner wrote the rule and is leading the race it created.
takes: Perfect process, no ceiling, twice.
The negotiation is the content, and the roast is the encore.

Snipe58.tagline: The quiet buyer whose bet just paid.
file: The type
A win-now buyer who pays with the future. Stays out of the chat and lets the transaction log do the talking.
Signature move
Quietly converting picks into veterans. Deebo Samuel cost a 2027 2nd, Jake Ferguson cost Colston Loveland, and Matthew Stafford cost two future 2nds and $100 of FAAB.
Nemesis
Darkspaces, who is both his supplier and the manager he trails by 7.06 MAXPF points for the 1.01.
The desk is watching
Whether Stafford keeps converting, and whether the 1.02 turns into the 1.01.

2026.headline: Stafford converts, up three spots, and the 1.02
story: Snipe58 does not post much, but the ledger is loud. He bought Deebo Samuel for a 2027 2nd, traded Loveland for Ferguson, and paid a 2028 2nd, a 2029 2nd and $100 of FAAB for Stafford. Each deal was a present-tense purchase funded with future capital, and in Week 5 the biggest one finally paid.

Stafford led the lineup at 27.32 in a 114.88 to 74.8 win over Sarge71, with 15.62 left on the bench. The record is 3-2, up three spots to 6th. The roster has the pieces: Justin Jefferson was the Week 1 MVP at 31.2, Brock Purdy the Week 3 MVP at 31.28, and Quinshon Judkins led Week 4 at 21.6.

The 566.44 points are the second-lowest in the league and the 549.44 against are the fewest, so the schedule has been kind. His 656.34 MAXPF gives him the 1.02, 7.06 points behind Darkspaces for the 1.01. FAAB is $400.
takes: Buys the present, sells the future, and finally got paid.
Quiet is a strategy. Eventually it needs a win.

StealingGas.tagline: The tank that scored a perfect 202.54.
file: The type
A self-declared tanker with a competitor's wallet. Announces the plan, then spends against it, and in Week 5 scored against it.
Signature move
The announcement-then-purchase combo: tank declared in Week 2, $99 on Stribling immediately, then $298 on Jaxson Dart.
Nemesis
The draft rule. A perfect 202.54 raised his MAXPF and cost him the 1.03.
The desk is watching
Whether he sells scorers before the deadline. He told the chat he may have no firsts by then, and FAAB is down to $98.

2026.headline: 2-3, the 1.04, and a perfect 202.54
story: StealingGas opened the year with the league's worst score at 83.32, repeated it with 77.18 in Week 2, and announced the tank. Then he spent $99 on a waiver dart, followed it with $298 on Jaxson Dart, and posted a perfect 152.42 lineup to beat Darkspaces by 83 in Week 3. Week 4 brought a 133.5 loss to Johnny4Skins, and Week 5 brought a 202.54 lineup with nothing left on the bench.

That perfect week beat YesChef23 by 114.4 with Puka Nacua at 37.7, and it moved him up four spots to 7th at 2-3. It also raised his MAXPF to 735.24, which slid him from the 1.03 to the 1.04, with YesChef23 taking the 1.03. Week 5 moves were small: Geno Smith in from free agency, Kendre Miller out.

The chat bits stay reliable. He asked Darkspaces whether his brain injury was new, said he is interested in the Swift sweepstakes, said he would trade for Drake Maye, and admitted he may have no firsts come trade deadline, after the London deal that brought him Drake London, Taylen Green and a 2027 1st. The desk is taking notes, and the draft rule is taking points.
takes: The best week of the season was also the most expensive.
A tank with a 202.54 on the scoreboard is a tank with a hobby.

Zygon.tagline: The IR Predictor. The formula lost, and the unbeaten label with it.
file: The type
The algorithm manager. Builds the roster around production, then lets the numbers run.
Signature move
Listing handcuffs on the block as a dare. Emmett Johnson and Blake Corum are posted with the line make me regret it when Walker tears his ACL.
Nemesis
Josh Allen. He asked for food poisoning on him and lost to the manager who owns him.
The desk is watching
Whether the Week 6 bounce-back comes against fumbduckdumbfuck, and what Corum and the handcuffs do now that the schedule gets harder.

2026.headline: 4-1, the unbeaten label gone, and a plea for food poisoning
story: Zygon was the only unbeaten team through four weeks, and the only one that barely touched the waiver wire. His FAAB spend is $7: $2 on Ollie Gordon and $5 on Jacoby Brissett. The team is built on Jaxon Smith-Njigba, Kenneth Walker and Patrick Mahomes and has the league's highest points total at 786.82.

Week 5 was the first loss. He asked the chat for food poisoning on Josh Allen to keep his undefeated status, then lost 154.24 to 124.36 to C33DeezNutzz, who owns Allen. Jacoby Brissett led at 26.28, 21.8 stayed on the bench. He also added the Jaguars defense for free, dropping the Bears.

He is still 4-1, tied with Johnny4Skins at the top, and holds the 1.11. FAAB is $493. The desk's view is the same as before: the formula is hard to write around, and now it has a loss to write about. The Week 6 test is fumbduckdumbfuck.
takes: The formula does not bid on anyone, and it does not control Josh Allen.
Elite bit commitment: the nickname, the 4-0, and the first loss.

Hades9mm.tagline: The sleeper puss, wide awake, with a second loss.
file: The type
A balanced, hand-built roster and a buyer's budget. Every one of his 23 picks was his own, which is the rarest thing in this league.
Signature move
Selling a star for depth. The London deal moved Drake London for Quentin Johnston, Cam Ward, TreVeyon Henderson and a 2027 3rd.
Nemesis
The bench. He left 37.06 on it in Week 5 and 29.1 in Week 4, and lost both.
The desk is watching
The league's highest MAXPF at 927.48, the 1.12, and the 3-2 record that says the lineup is not the roster.

2026.headline: 3-2 and the best roster on paper that keeps losing weeks
story: Hades9mm drafted every one of his 23 picks himself, and the roster shows it: Jayden Daniels and Jared Goff at quarterback, Amon-Ra St. Brown and London at receiver, Derrick Henry and Cam Skattebo at running back, Kittle and Kelce at tight end. He started 3-0, then lost to Zygon in Week 4 and to Painty69 in Week 5.

Week 5 was a 153.1 to 126.24 loss to Painty69, a matchup he called a victory royal in the chat. Jared Goff led at 28.94, and 37.06 stayed on the bench while the bench scored 54.46. He picked up Devaughn Vele for free and is now 3rd in the standings, still second in points at 743.42. FAAB is $330.

The files feud with Darkspaces is still his best content: four 1sts for Mendoza, Maye, Achane and Egbuka, followed by a threat to release the trade-talk logs. The desk's view: the best possible lineup in the league, 927.48 of MAXPF, is not the same as the best lineup set.
takes: The best ceiling in the league, and the bench keeps the receipt.
Victory royal, on paper.

file: The type
The league's most hands-off roster. Johnny4Skins drafted a few good players, then left the room and let the system finish the job.
Signature move
Not spending. $500 of FAAB intact, and the only moves are free ones.
Nemesis
Injuries to either quarterback, and Zygon, who beat him by 70 in Week 1.
The desk is watching
The 27.3 points left on the bench in Week 5, and CMac91 in Week 6.

2026.headline: 4-1, second place, and a new QB for free
story: Johnny4Skins took Ja'Marr Chase and Lamar Jackson in the first two rounds, then went to dinner. The autopick drafted eighteen of his players, including Jalen Hurts, A.J. Brown, Tyler Warren, Kyren Williams, Brian Thomas and DK Metcalf. Not a single human opinion went into any of them.

It keeps working. After the Week 1 loss to Zygon he has won four straight, and in Week 5 he beat Darkspaces 163.56 to 140.36 with Jaylen Warren at 36.8, leaving 27.3 on the bench. He added Jalon Daniels for free and dropped Jordan James. He is 4-1, second in the standings, and his $500 of FAAB is untouched.
The roster is dual-QB by design or by accident, and now has a third name. The account was Cassellrole until October. Next up: CMac91, with a 147-point average against a 128 one.
takes: The robot spent nothing and won again.
A good autopick is still not a plan, but it is a pattern.

Sarge71.tagline: The engine without the cast, and the worst bench in the league.
file: The type
A top-end roster with nothing underneath. Star power at running back, and a bench that cannot cover a bye week.
Signature move
The quiet transaction. One move this season, cutting Jaxson Dart, watching StealingGas pay $298 for him, and taking Aaron Rodgers instead.
Nemesis
The bench. 45.5 left on it in Week 5 in a 74.8 loss by 40.08.
The desk is watching
Whether the roster adds one real depth piece, and whether the FAAB budget ever opens.

2026.headline: 1-4, last place, and more on the bench than the margin
story: Sarge71 started 0-3 with points that would win in a weaker schedule, then beat Painty69 by 1.34 in Week 4. Week 5 brought a 114.88 to 74.8 loss to Snipe58, with Aaron Rodgers leading at 22.0 and 45.5 left on the bench. Sleeper's weekly report says he missed his projection by 40%.

The roster is Bijan Robinson and a supporting cast that scores on its own schedule. Tetairoa McMillan went for 45.2 in Week 4 and Robinson has two MVP weeks. He cut Jaxson Dart, watched StealingGas bid $298 on him, and replaced him with Aaron Rodgers.

At 1-4 he is 12th in the standings and holds the 1.05. His 749.96 points against are the most in the league. FAAB is untouched at $500, and the more useful move is still a trade, which Sarge71 has not made.
takes: Sarge has the engine and, some weeks, a bench that outscores it.
The schedule is mean. The lineup is meaner.

C33DeezNutzz.tagline: The efficient one. BBQnBBWs beat the formula.
file: The type
A quiet, efficient contender. Cleanest lineup management on the board.
Signature move
The workmanlike win. Josh Allen as the engine and a steady lineup behind him.
Nemesis
Hades9mm, who beat him in Week 2, and fumbduckdumbfuck, who beat him by 12.1 in Week 4.
The desk is watching
Painty69 in Week 6, and FAAB, which is untouched at $500.

2026.headline: 3-2, the unbeaten slayer, and a bench that scored 49.1
story: C33DeezNutzz opened with a 195.82, the highest score of Week 1, with Josh Allen providing 35.66, then lost to Hades9mm in Week 2 despite 40.82 from Allen, then beat CMac91 in Week 3 and lost to fumbduckdumbfuck in Week 4. Week 5 was the Match of the Week.

He beat Zygon 154.24 to 124.36 with Christian Watson at 32.3, leaving 18.0 on the bench while the bench scored 49.1. The desk called Zygon the formula and C33DeezNutzz the process. The process won, and Zygon had asked the chat for food poisoning on Allen.
He is 3-2, fourth in the standings and third in points at 736.64, and holds the 1.08. FAAB is a full $500, and the desk keeps asking when it becomes a weapon. Painty69 is next.
takes: The cleanest lineup in the league just ended the only perfect record.
Quiet is not the same as safe, but it is close.

Painty69.tagline: Elite top end, a robot bottom, and a win.
file: The type
A star at running back and almost nothing else. Made his last real pick in round 6 and let the CPU draft the remaining seventeen rounds.
Signature move
The silence. He promised to be positive and kind through the whole draft and has been quiet since Week 2.
Nemesis
YesChef23, who needles him in the restaurant arc, and the bench points that decide his close losses.
The desk is watching
C33DeezNutzz in Week 6, and whether Gibbs gets a second scorer.

2026.headline: The first win, and the league has no winless team
story: Painty69 took Jahmyr Gibbs at 1.01, then McCaffrey and Barkley back to back, and then stopped. The last real pick was in round 6, and the CPU made the remaining seventeen, tying him with Johnny4Skins at eighteen autopicks.

Week 5 was the first win. He beat Hades9mm 153.1 to 126.24 with Jahmyr Gibbs at 37.7, the best RB of the week, and left 21.14 on the bench. The earlier losses were by 12.7, 32.3, 4.7 and 1.34. He is 1-4, 11th in the standings, with 650.24 points, sixth in the league.

He did not say a word in the Week 5 chat. Darkspaces and StealingGas used his name for a joke and he did not answer. The silence is the character. He holds the 1.09 on MAXPF, and a top-end roster with a robot bottom can still win.
takes: Gibbs did the job. The robot did not ruin it.
Positive and kind, and still silent.

CMac91.tagline: The depth collector who finally went off, and then went the other way.
file: The type
The league's most patient manager. Builds depth, stays out of drama, and has not spent a dollar of FAAB.
Signature move
Adding depth at no cost. Jaydon Blue, Travis Hunter and Kimani Vidal arrived without a bid.
Nemesis
The bench. 47.98 points left on it in Week 5, more than the 47.46 he lost by.
The desk is watching
Whether the Week 4 breakout was a visit, and Johnny4Skins in Week 6.

2026.headline: 74.52, the week's lowest score, and the bench that outscored the margin
story: CMac91 asked in round 5 whether there were seriously 23 rounds, played through round 11, and let the robot finish the draft, which gave him twelve autopicks. The first-round pick was James Cook, followed by CeeDee Lamb at 2.02 and Bo Nix at 3.02.

Week 4 brought 183.42, the high score of the week. Week 5 brought 74.52, the lowest score of the week, a 121.98 to 74.52 loss to fumbduckdumbfuck, 47.98 left on the bench and James Cook at 22.8 as the MVP. Sleeper's weekly report says he scored 61% of his perfect lineup. CeeDee Lamb came up in the chat, but he did not lead the lineup.
At 2-3 he fell three spots to 8th. FAAB is a full $500 and the 1.06 is his. The desk's view is the same as before: the roster is fine and the lineup is the problem.
takes: Depth first, spending never, and the bench in charge.
It works, until it does not.

YesChef23.tagline: The restaurant arc. Wins ugly, complains loudly, and lost ugly again.
file: The type
A chef who wins while complaining. Chatty in the draft room, aggressive on waivers, and 2-3 with the lowest points total in the league.
Signature move
Cheap waiver insurance. $1 on Deshaun Watson when Caleb Williams went down, $1 on J.J. McCarthy the week after, and in Week 4 $12 on Keon Coleman.
Nemesis
StealingGas, who beat him by 114.4 in Week 5, and Painty69, who he has needled since the draft room.
The desk is watching
George Pickens on the block, the 25.46 left on the bench, and the 1.03 he just took.

2026.headline: 88.14, a 114.4-point loss, and the 1.03
story: YesChef23 opened the draft fighting an Uber Eats driver who stole a customer's order, took shots at the turtle ass drafters, and threatened to take defenses the rest of the way before settling for two. He beat fumbduckdumbfuck in Week 1, lost to Zygon by 92.86 in Week 2, and beat Painty69 in Week 3 by 4.68.

The roster is built on Caleb Williams and Jeremiyah Love, and when Williams went down he paid $1 for Deshaun Watson and then $1 for J.J. McCarthy. Week 5 brought no claims and an 88.14 to 202.54 loss to StealingGas, with George Pickens leading at 28.0 and 25.46 left on the bench. He is 2-3 and fell two spots to 10th.

His 544.32 points are the lowest in the league, which means his 698.48 MAXPF gave him the 1.03 when StealingGas passed him. FAAB is $484. Mevis and I have the same body type was his line of the week, and it was about a kicker.
takes: The 1.03 came from someone else's perfect week.
The cheapest insurance policy in the league, and the lowest points total.

file: The type
The desk's preseason favorite, and a roster that is better than the record. Fifth in the standings and in points.
Signature move
Quietly good at running back. Jeanty, Taylor and Bowers form a core that scores every week.
Nemesis
YesChef23, who ended the Issue 1 No. 1 label in Week 1, and Hades9mm, who beat him by 12 in Week 3.
The desk is watching
The quarterback room, and Zygon in Week 6.

2026.headline: 3-2, 5th, and a 47.46-point win
story: fumbduckdumbfuck was the desk's number one in Issue 1, and the roster still supports it: Brock Bowers at 1.12, Ashton Jeanty at 2.01, Jonathan Taylor at 3.01, with Rashee Rice, DeVonta Smith and Dak Prescott behind them. He is 3-2 with 652.86 points and sits 5th, up one spot.

Week 5 was a 121.98 to 74.52 win over CMac91 with Brock Bowers leading at 23.0, the best TE of the week, and 17.92 left on the bench. The losses were close: 113.10 to 127.06 against YesChef23 in Week 1 and 127.74 to 139.80 against Hades9mm in Week 3. The wins were a 156.16 to 110.60 beat-down of Sarge71 in Week 2 and a 133.88 to 121.78 win over C33DeezNutzz in Week 4.

The quarterback room is still the open question. Kyler Murray arrived free in Week 4, cut by StealingGas earlier in the week. The 795.48 MAXPF gives him the 1.07 and the record says the roster is finally being realized. Zygon is next.
takes: Bowers did the real work.
The Issue 1 No. 1 label is a lot to carry, but it is lighter at 3-2.

desk: Week 5 broke both of last issue's headlines. Zygon, the only unbeaten team, lost the Match of the Week to C33DeezNutzz, and Painty69, the only winless team, beat Hades9mm. Zygon and Johnny4Skins now share the top at 4-1. The rest of the week belonged to StealingGas: a perfect lineup, 202.54 with nothing left on the bench, the best score in the league and a 114.4-point win over YesChef23.

MAXPF, the points each week's best possible lineup would have scored, added up, sets the 2027 rookie draft order, which is why a perfect week is not all good news. StealingGas's best lineup is now worth more, his slot slid from the 1.03 to the 1.04, and YesChef23 holds the 1.03. At the top, Darkspaces set a second straight perfect lineup, 140.36 with nothing left on the bench, and lost again, this time by 23.2 to Johnny4Skins. He holds the 1.01 by 7.06 points of MAXPF over Snipe58. No block player has moved, and the chat spent the week on food poisoning, a gif of a nuclear bomb, and a commissioner who says his IR slot is staying put.
